blocks.text: Alepo calls this AI network operations: AI that reads the live data of the product it sits in and answers the person in front of it. The industry often calls this **agentic AI for telecom**. At Alepo, a person stays in charge of every decision.

items: TACACS+ console: AI Agent Assist explains who was allowed to do what. Its recommendations are drafts only.
Alepo CRM: AI Agent Assist is docked on the customer page with 14 read-only tools.
AAA console: AI Agent Assist was built from a large fiber operator's top 18 support cases. It is in beta.
Web and app: the AI Customer Assistant has been live with subscribers since January 2024.

blocks.text: Both run on the same live data as the products underneath them. All of it is read-only. It sees only what the signed-in person may see.

A virtual agent on your website and app. It answers routine questions around the clock, completes account tasks through the BSS inside the signed-in customer's own account, and hands complex cases to people.

items: Speaks the customer's language on web and app
Makes offers inside the conversation, such as a travel-data pass or a speed boost

blocks.text: In beta. An assistant inside your care and network consoles. It answers staff questions from live data and explains bills and failures, with a suggested next step.

sections.h2: Clear limits for AI in telecom

blocks.text: Responsible **AI in telecom** starts with clear limits.

items: AI Agent Assist answers and suggests. A person takes every action.
AI Agent Assist answers within each staff member's own permissions.
It is read-only.
In the TACACS+ console, recommendations are drafts only.
It can run on your own language model, if you prefer.
It is switched on for each operator separately.
Answers show their sources, such as session history or account restrictions.
The AI Customer Assistant hands complex cases to people.
Your customer data is never used to train AI for other companies.
